---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a scoped Carryforth improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What user or contributor problem should this solve?

## Proposed outcome

Describe the observable behavior, not only an implementation.

## Scope and boundaries

- Which supported component is affected?
- Does this change identity, authorization, networking, migrations, data
  retention, wire/storage contracts, or release behavior?
- What is explicitly out of scope?

## Alternatives

What alternatives or workarounds have you considered?

## Acceptance evidence

How should maintainers verify that the change works and preserves existing
data?
